actions: Continue the $1.50 discount on the $6 breakfast Meal Deal via app in the 15 consenting franchise stores through March 2027 with weekly monitoring and opt-in/stop rules.

Launch a new limited-time $2.00 'Early Bird Bundle' discount for mobile orders placed between 7:00–8:00 a.m. on weekdays at the same 15 stores, capped at 100 redemptions per week to control costs and monitor profitability.
Implement enhanced local marketing emphasizing the convenience and value of mobile ordering with the discounted bundles, targeting habitual app users and commuters near pilot Starbucks cafés.
moves.rationale: Maintaining the existing $1.50 discount sustains momentum and customer interest in the breakfast Meal Deal, which aligns with Dunkin's value positioning. Introducing a higher-value 'Early Bird Bundle' discount during peak mobile order hours incentivizes earlier orders, smoothing peak demand and improving predictability. Capping redemptions controls financial risk within the $20,000 monthly budget. Enhanced marketing supports customer awareness and app adoption, aiming to capture habitual app users switching from Starbucks and Dutch Bros due to their mobile order constraints.
resource_commitments: Allocate up to $12,000 per month for combined discounts and local marketing within the $20,000 monthly envelope.
Dedicate approximately $8,000 monthly to incremental staffing adjustments during peak hours to ensure order fulfillment and maintain service quality.
Use weekly monitoring data to adjust or halt offers in stores where economics worsen, ensuring franchisee willingness to continue participation.
expected_responses: Starbucks may continue to limit mobile order slots and maintain café order reservations, potentially causing habitual app users to increasingly switch to Dunkin's more predictable mobile offers.
Dutch Bros might respond with enhanced loyalty promotions or increased peak staffing to defend their Order Ahead customer base.
Some commuters and habitual app users will likely shift to Dunkin's mobile offers due to improved value and reliability, while café visitors may remain loyal to Starbucks for in-person experience.
